ns2:section.sectionText: Critical Dialogue: Addressing Substance Misuse in Marginalized Communities This course focuses on building students' skills in facilitating Critical Dialogue, an evidence-based group dialogue intervention to address privilege and oppression among people with substance use disorders residing in marginalized communities. This course differentiates the critical dialogue method from other traditional substance use treatment approaches and utilizes critical consciousness theory, critical thinking, and empowerment as frameworks in the treatment of substance use disorders among marginalized populations.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MSW:Social Work -UIUC.
